data.name: Satyashil
data.gender_notes: Satyashil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the words 'Satya' meaning truth and 'Shila' meaning stone or rock. The name Satyashil carries the meaning “Truthful Stone” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Satyashil usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes someone who is as strong and unyielding as a rock, yet truthful in character.
data.etymology: Satyashil belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful Stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satyashil total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This name is enjoyed in various regions of India and is considered auspicious as it reflects the virtues of honesty, integrity, and strength.

historical_references.reference: Satyashil was a renowned Hindu philosopher and scholar from the 12th century who contributed significantly to the development of the Bhakti movement in India. He was a disciple of the Alvars and is believed to have composed several hymns in Tamil language, known as the 'Divya Prabandham'. These hymns express the devotion and love towards various Hindu deities, particularly Lord Vishnu and his avatars. Satyashil's works played a crucial role in the growth of Bhakti movement in the southern Indian regions.

Satyashil was also a celebrated Jain scholar from the 13th or 14th century who wrote commentaries on several Jain texts. He is best known for his work 'Sarvasravakabhushana', a commentary on the 'Agama Sastra', which is one of the most important Jain scriptures. Satyashil's commentaries provided in-depth analysis and interpretations of Jain doctrines, contributing significantly to the preservation and dissemination of Jain knowledge during this period.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Satyashil continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
